findings.evidence: `TauCeti/Topology/Frontier.lean:185` proves `frontier V ∩ closure A = frontier V ∩ frontier A` from only `A ⊆ V`; `TauCeti/Analysis/Complex/Conformal/ClusterSet.lean:324` already demonstrates this theorem with `image_mono hVU`.
findings.fix: Delete both declarations and use `frontier_inter_closure_eq_frontier_inter_frontier (image_mono inter_subset_left)` or `(image_mono sdiff_subset)` directly at consumers.
findings.issue: Both `frontier_inter_closure_image_inter_ball_eq_inter_frontier` (line 233) and `frontier_inter_closure_image_sdiff_closedBall_eq_inter_frontier` (line 249) specialize the existing `TauCeti.frontier_inter_closure_eq_frontier_inter_frontier`, while adding unnecessary analytic hypotheses.

summary: Two new frontier-shape declarations directly duplicate an existing, strictly more general TauCeti theorem.
